% --8<-- [start:time_goal_1]
test("time") :-
    time_goal(append([1, 2], [3, 4], _)).
% --8<-- [end:time_goal_1]

% --8<-- [start:time_goal_2]
test("measure") :-
    time_goal(length(_, 1000), SECS),
    SECS < 1.0.
% --8<-- [end:time_goal_2]

% --8<-- [start:benchmark_recipe]
compare_approaches(GOAL_A, GOAL_B) :-
    time_goal(GOAL_A, TIME_A),
    time_goal(GOAL_B, TIME_B),
    format("A: ~ws, B: ~ws~n", [TIME_A, TIME_B]).
% --8<-- [end:benchmark_recipe]
